summary: Legacy radio-button visual, hidden from the node picker — superseded by net.noodl.controls.radiobutton.
description: The original Radio Button visual, kept only so old projects load. The Radio Button control (net.noodl.controls.radiobutton), used inside a Radio Button Group, supersedes it with group value handling, visual states and accessibility.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.controls.radiobutton instead.
